name: PARDUS Spark RS custom build
why_interesting: An exact-model custom build and exact official Spark RS pages identify a high-performance branch separately from the broader Spark family and its factory Rival trim.
missing: Map the custom post's frame generation and color to the official Spark RS classic page

facts.drivetrain: Custom build: Shimano 105 mechanical with R8170 crank/chain upgrade
facts.frame_material: Generation conflict: the community lead reports T800, while the current official Spark RS classic page specifies HS-EPS+ carbon and an HS-HPT carbon fork; the custom bike is not mapped to that generation
facts.frame_construction: The current official classic platform uses fully hidden routing, an integrated carbon cockpit and asymmetric stays, but these details are not transferred to the unresolved white custom build

source_note: Official exact-model product and dealer routes are established. The public record remains an owner build rather than a factory configuration, and its mentioned price drop has no defensible amount. The official Spark RS classic page separately lists an HS-EPS+ frame, hidden-cable cockpit, SRAM Rival hydraulic 2×11 and PW-5 DB alloy wheels.
